game_title: Comparison Duel – Lava Tube Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by lava imps.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the volcanologist's power beats the shield shown by lava imps. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 15.
